conditions.note: Synthetic sine PCM for STT (not human speech) — measures engine wall time, not recognition quality.

stagesMs.vadNote: Product adds ~silenceHangMs+postRollMs of AUDIO time after last speech before STT. Probe loop wall time is not that delay.
stagesMs.playbackNote: Not measured — requires interactive PipeWire session.
stagesMs.llmNote: Not measured — would consume tokens; out of scope for this probe.
stagesMs.pipelineNote: Sum of configured VAD audio hang+postRoll + measured STT wall + measured TTS wall. Excludes mic I/O, LLM, and playback.
